coverage_definition: Main successful nominal/revised Benthol A target network and C-fragment preparations, including recycle 8 to 7 and analytical polyol 32. Known epoxide and A/B precursors bound companion-paper coverage; unassigned crude mixtures and separate model/analytical studies remain outside scope.

issues.detail: Nominal 1 is not the natural-product structure. Actual 40-epi-1 differs only at C40; graphs, events and routes remain distinct.
issues.subject: 1/40-epi-1

issues.detail: Detailed preparations of common epoxide 2 and A/B fragments are in the accompanying paper. Main three-operation preparation from L-aspartic acid is represented as a grouped transformation with explicitly unresolved internal graphs; A/B fragments are known source-drawn starting blocks.
issues.subject: 2/38/40-epi-38/41

issues.detail: Successful target network, H-fragment recycle and polyol 32 preparation included. Mosher/acetonide analytical derivatisations, AB/BC model coupling studies, catalyst synthesis and silica-induced rearrangements 44/45 are outside this target-route dataset.
issues.subject: analytical/model branches

issues.detail: Interpreted internal graphs labeled explicitly. Partial TBS-cleavage/enol-silylation mixtures and solution organoborane speciation are not fabricated as discrete compounds.
issues.subject: mesylate/AD/diol/borane

issues.detail: Authors report LLS 32 and total step count 93 across this and the accompanying paper. Database operation records follow reported isolations and graph-resolvable stages; these metrics are not asserted to reproduce the authors combined-paper count.
issues.subject: operation counts

issues.detail: Main assigns 93% to cross-metathesis whereas SI says over two steps; separate 9 preparation is 95%. Retain conflict rather than multiply into a claimed total.
Main 52% over two steps versus SI 52% from isolated 8a; preceding oxidation qualitative quantitative.
issues.subject: 7 recycle

issues.detail: First hydrostannation is 83%; 82% is two-operation overall yield. Iodine-exchange yield is not separately assigned.
Some doubly charged sodium entries label M+Na despite ion formula containing Na2. Full reported formula, charge and discrepant adduct label retained; formula and mass checked using both sodium ions.
issues.subject: 42/43 HRMS

issues.detail: Major source structures retained for incompletely assigned minor diastereomer mixtures; no unsupported minor configurations inferred.
issues.subject: S7/11

issues.detail: Reagent and solvent identities normalized; full time/temperature/stoichiometry standardization remains pending. Some scheme/procedure quantities and catalyst loadings disagree.
issues.subject: all

report_heading: Benthol A: nominal structure and revised natural product
report_note: 67 molecular records, 48 reaction events and six paths. Nominal and revised C40 epimers remain distinct; companion-paper precursor boundaries, grouped crude transformations and source yield/adduct conflicts remain explicit. Independent chemist review pending.
source_visual_review: Main successful schemes, SI primary preparation drawings and target structures inspected. Carbon backbone 1-72, branches 73-75, 22 hydroxyls, eight cyclic ethers, 35 stereocenters, C46/C62 source R assignments and 49 analytical formulas crosschecked.
